name: smwsprites-flutter-flying-wiggler
title: Flutter / Flying Wiggler
description:
A wiggler that behaves like the one from SMW2:YI. It flies forward in a sine wave, but when stomped, it gets mad and chases the player.

This sprite was part of smkdan's YI Sprite Pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.
